story.title: Doctor Donut
paragraphs_en: Doctor Donut was the busiest doctor in the Dessert Hospital. His patients loved his sweet medicines and his gentle treatments. He rolled out of his room for his daily visits to the various wards, in his white chocolate coat, with nurse Croissant jogging behind him. His first stop was the sponge cake room, to check his patients.

“Doc, ours bums are paining,” three round cakes waddled over the table. “Does it pain while sitting?”the doctor asked. “Yes,” the cakes replied. “Stick cherries and strawberries heated in maple syrup to their bottom,” Doctor Donut told the nurse. “And make them lie upside down until they feel better.”
“We are feeling cold,” several funny shaped cakes shivered. “A bath with pink chocolate will make them feel better,” the doctor said to the nurse.

“What about me doc?” a round cake asked. “I’m feeling very itchy.” “Do you have rashes?” “No, I just feel like scratching.” “A dressing of white cream and blue icing sugar will cure it,” Doctor Donut smiled at the flaky cake.

“Doc help me,” said a heart shaped cake with a large crack across it. “Do you have any pain?" doctor donut asked. “No,” the cake replied. “I just feel cold and tired.” The kind doctor smiled. “Nurse, cover him with a thick colourful blanket and stick gems, flowers and leaves over him."

Doctor Donut rolled out of the room, wheeling down the corridor with nurse Croissant jogging behind him. He stopped outside the cup-cake ward. The small cakes, with human faces, were groaning in pain, clutching their stomachs, they rolled from side to side.

“Doc, we’ve a hollow feeling in our stomachs,” they rubbed their bellies. “Hmmm…” Doctor Donut prodded the cakes with a candy cane. He made a few of them turn upside down. “This is an epidemic,” he frowned. “Get the injections ready,” he said to the nurse. “Please doc, no syringes,” the cup-cakes shivered in fear.

“Not even injections filled with hot chocolate?” the doctor’s kind eyes’ twinkled. “I promise that you won’t feel any pain,” he smiled. “Infact, you will feel nice and warm.” “No,” the cup-cakes said running all over the room. Doctor Donut frowned. This epidemic was contagious. If he couldn’t treat it, then within a short time it would spread across the hospital and there would be no desserts left.

“Let nurse put you to sleep,” the doctor said gently. “We’ll decide your treatment in the morning.” The cup-cakes lay down on their backs. Nurse Croissant fed them a spoonful of hot milk with honey. Within a few minutes the cup-cakes were snoring soundly.

Filling a syringe with hot chocolate, Doctor Donut jabbed the cupcakes in their stomach. As the hot chocolate filled their stomachs, their stomachs swelled. “Cover them with a red velvet blanket,” Doctor Donut told the nurse. “They will be completely alright by tomorrow morning.”
